```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(chromVAR)
  library(betterChromVAR)
  library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
  library(data.table)
  library(edgeR)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(MotifDb)
  library(TFBSTools)
  library(universalmotif)
  library(memes)
  library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
})
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ETHZ-INS/DTFAB/refs/heads/main/Scripts/GCnorm.R")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
se <- readRDS("/mnt/germain/datasets/CusanovichATACprotocols/mergedPeaks_SE2.rds")
sra <- read.delim("/mnt/germain/datasets/CusanovichATACprotocols/SraRunTable.txt", sep=",")
md <- fread("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE174nnn/GSE174280/matrix/GSE174280-GPL21697_series_matrix.txt.gz", skip = 39)
md <- setNames(gsub("-Rep[0-9]+","",colnames(md)[-1]), md[1,-1])
sra$name <- md[sra$GEO_Accession..exp.]
md <- as.data.frame(t(sapply(strsplit(sra$name, "-"), \(x) x[c(2,4:6)])))
colnames(md) <- c("Nuclei", "Buffer", "Temperature", "Tn5")
sra <- cbind(sra, md)
row.names(sra) <- paste(sra$Experiment, sra$GEO_Accession..exp., sep=".")
colData(se) <- DataFrame(sra[colnames(se),c("Bases",colnames(md))])

se <- keepStandardChromosomes(se, pruning.mode = "coarse")
seqlevelsStyle(se) <- "UCSC"
se <- addGCBias(se, BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
assay(se, "GCQN") <- GCQuantileNorm(se)
flbias <- rowData(se)$flbias
rowData(se)$flbias <- NULL
se <- CVnorm(se, toAssay="CVnorm")
rowData(se)$flbias <- flbias
se <- CVnorm(se, toAssay="CVnorm+FL", bs = c(40,40,6))
saveRDS(se, file="Cusanovich_SE.rds")
```

```{r}
se <- readRDS("Cusanovich_SE.rds")
```


```{r}
norms <- lapply(assays(se), \(x){ cor(log1p(as.matrix(x))) })
names(norms)[1] <- "raw"
ss <- row.names(sechm::sortRows(norms[[1]]))
saveRDS(ss, file="Cusanovich_sampleOrder.rds")
cc <- do.call(cbind, lapply(norms, \(x) x[ss,ss]))
method <- factor(rep(names(norms),each=ncol(se)), names(norms))
df <- colData(se)[row.names(cc),c("Nuclei","Temperature","Buffer")]
df$Buffer <- gsub("_TD","",df$Buffer)

coltitles <- as.expression(lapply(names(norms), function(x) {
  y <- norms[[x]]
  avg_rho <- round(mean(y[lower.tri(y)]), 2)
  bquote(atop(.(x), bar(rho) == .(avg_rho)))
}))
cols <- list(Temperature=c("37C"="#56B4E9", "55C"="#E69F00"),
             Buffer=c(THS="#F0E442", Omni="#0072B2", Nextera="#D55E00"),
             Nuclei=c(Native="#009E73", Fixed="#CC79A7"))
rowAnno <- rowAnnotation(df=df, col=cols, annotation_name_side="top", annotation_name_gp=gpar(fontsize=10))

Heatmap(cc, cluster_columns=FALSE, cluster_rows=FALSE, left_annotation = rowAnno,
        column_split = method, column_title=coltitles, name="Pearson\ncorrelation",
        show_row_names = FALSE, show_column_names = FALSE)

```
